cues: Worked example ten point three, a detective problem.
Lucas turbidity in five minutes says secondary.
A blue Victor Meyer colour confirms it.
The only secondary alcohol with formula C four H ten O is butan two ol.
It has the C H three C H O H group, so the iodoform test fits.
Oxidising a secondary alcohol gives a ketone, butanone, which cannot reduce Fehling's solution.
So A is butan two ol and B is butanone.
